Chart container

Source: R/v2-chart-container.R
shad_chart_container.Rd

A card-styled wrapper that gives R plot output (a shiny::plotOutput(), htmlwidget, canvas, or inline SVG) the shadcn chart look: header title / description, an aspect-locked body, an optional legend strip auto-colored from the chart tokens, and a footer caption. Pair with the theming adapters in shad_theme_ggplot2() / shad_theme_plotly() so the plot itself follows the active theme.

Usage

shad_chart_container(
  ...,
  title = NULL,
  description = NULL,
  footer = NULL,
  legend = NULL,
  legend_labels = NULL,
  aspect = c("video", "square", "wide", "auto"),
  plain = FALSE,
  class = NULL
)

Arguments

...

The plot output (and any extra named attributes) placed in the chart body.

title

Optional chart title.

description

Optional description under the title.

footer

Optional footer caption.

legend

Optional legend: a named character vector c("Label" = color), or TRUE to auto-color a supplied legend_labels vector from the chart tokens, or a tag. NULL omits the legend.

legend_labels

Character labels used when legend = TRUE.

aspect

"video" (16:9, default), "square", "wide" (21:9), or "auto" (natural height).

plain

If TRUE, drop the card border/background (--plain variant).

class

Extra CSS classes.

Value

A chart-container <figure> tag.

See also

Other shadshiny dashboard: shad_timeline(), shad_timeline_item(), shad_value_box()

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  shad_chart_container(
    shiny::plotOutput("p"),
    title = "Monthly revenue", description = "Jan - Jun 2026"
  )
}
